_comment: What can be replaced in a repair. 'bn' is used in the note and the hand-written attestation (each word must exist in the handwriting bank for the attestation; see Settings → Handwriting), 'en' is the voucher line. 'head' is the default expense head (data/heads.json); it can be overridden per demand. 'rate' starts as a rough Dhaka market estimate and is overwritten by the last price actually paid. Head follows utils/Clarification.pdf: computer internals and laptop parts → কম্পিউটার মেরামত; peripherals (monitor, keyboard, mouse, printer, scanner, UPS, pendrive) and internet/network gear → অফিস সরঞ্জামাদি মেরামত. 'options' are the usual models for this office (mostly HP ProDesk/ProBook; DDR3 for 4th-gen-era HP, DDR4 for G3 and newer; network gear released 2021 or later): 'detail' goes on the voucher on its own line under the part name (no brackets: separate the spec's parts with commas), 'fits' is a hint shown in the form, 'rate' the default price and 'src' where it came from: 'Star Tech <date>' = retail price listed on startech.com.bd that day, 'estimate' = not listed (used/HP-specific parts, out of stock). 'detail' on the part itself is the last model actually bought.
